card.line: Edrei was a royal city of Og, king of Bashan, east of the Jordan, and the place where Israel defeated him as they moved toward the land God promised.

moments.title: Israel defeats King Og
moments.text: Og king of Bashan and his whole army came out to fight Israel at Edrei. The LORD told Moses not to fear, and Israel struck Og down and took his land.

moments.title: Moses remembers the victory
moments.text: Moses later reminded Israel that the LORD had delivered Og and his whole army into their hands. Israel captured all sixty of his cities.

moments.title: Og's land is given away
moments.text: Edrei was one of the royal cities of Og. Moses gave this land to the half-tribe of Manasseh, to the family of Machir.
